question: Should the named LiteLLM onboarding choice grow its own interactive base-URL and model-discovery setup, or should remote LiteLLM users be routed to the existing Custom Provider path?
rationale: Both outcomes are technically plausible, but the choice changes provider-owned onboarding UX, credentialed endpoint probing, and the boundary between bundled provider setup and generic custom endpoints.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have litellm-api-key ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving non-interactive --custom-base-url behavior.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM as localhost/default-model setup and update prompts/docs so remote LiteLLM proxies use Custom Provider.

options.title: Wait For Catalog Policy
options.body: Defer this until maintainers settle the broader credentialed model-discovery contract for provider plugins.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have litellm-api-key ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving non-interactive --custom-base-url behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent LiteLLM pluginization and non-interactive custom-base-url behavior that shape the decision point.
